_about: The v5 dataset's 69 human tasks and their RoboEval env classes; 31 colour/letter variants (variants.py), each its base task's scene recoloured or relettered, the combination with the most v5 synthetic demos (v5_demos); and the env settings every BimanualYAM demo records (its safetensors environment_data, without env_name and reset_positions). telearms_env.py builds each task's env from these, no demo needed. unrewarded_stages: stages the dense reward never pays, those fewer than half of a task's successful human demos pass through when their recorded states are replayed, success checked before the stage flags are read as TeleArmsEnv.step does (10-12 demos per task, 2026-11-12; Ascending Number Pyramid, Cube Bridge Stacking and Three Step Cube Staircase from the Hyak stage-1 export): optional moves like Red Left Of Blue's grasp of the blue cube, and stages the task's code never sets. Place Cube On Each Patch replays cannot be checked (its patches are not in the recorded state); its three stages are each cube resting on its own patch, which every success needs. privileged_dims: the length of each task's obs_mode='privileged' observation (telearms_env.privileged_obs: 14 + 13 per free object + 7 per goal patch), measured from a seed-0 reset. instructions: each task's short, LIBERO-style language instruction, the prompt its v5 and offline RL demos are labelled with.

instructions.Adjacent Color Cube Pairing: Pair red with blue on the left and green with yellow on the right.
instructions.Adjacent Red Cube Placement: Place the red cube next to the target.
instructions.Align Blocks: Put all blocks in one straight left-to-right row.
instructions.Aligned Cube Row Placement: Arrange blue, green, and red left to right, oriented alike.
instructions.Aligned Letter Cube Row: Arrange the letter cubes into one straight readable row.
instructions.Alphabet Cube Row Arrange: Place A, B, C from left to right facing the robot.
instructions.Alternate Green Yellow Row: Make a front-to-back row: green, yellow, green, yellow.
instructions.Alternate Red Blue Row: Build a row of blue, red, blue, red from left to right.
instructions.Arrange Alphabetical Order: Put the letters in order from left to right, faces up.
instructions.Arrange Numbers: Line up the numbers from smallest to largest, left to right, faces up.
instructions.Arrange Shapes: Arrange the blocks into the requested shape.
instructions.Arrange Word: Spell the requested word on the top faces from left to right.
instructions.Ascending Number Pyramid: Line up 4, 5, 6, then stack 2 on 4, 3 on 5, and 1 on 2, numbers facing the robot.
instructions.Block Line Arrangement: Place all cubes in one straight left-to-right row.
instructions.Blue Base Red Pyramid: Build a pyramid with two blue cubes below and red on top.
instructions.Blue Cube On Red Target: Center the blue cube on the red patch.
instructions.Blue On Red Stack To Green Target: Put red on the green patch and blue on top.
instructions.Centered Semantic Cube Row: Make a row with the letter cube between the two colored cubes, letter readable.
instructions.Colored Cube Row Arrangement: Make a straight row: red, blue, green, yellow.
instructions.Cube Bridge Stacking: Build a bridge: two cubes side by side with one cube across them.
instructions.Cube Center Placement: Move the colored cube to the center of the workspace.
instructions.Cube Cluster Center: Cluster the cubes near the center without stacking.
instructions.Cube Forward Right Placement: Place the blue cube on the white forward-right target.
instructions.Cube Midpoint Placement: Place green on the green midpoint target between red and blue.
instructions.Cube Patch Placement: Put red on the green patch and blue on the yellow patch.
instructions.Cube Row Arrangement: Arrange all cubes in one evenly spaced left-to-right row.
instructions.Cube Zigzag Arrangement: Make a left-to-right zigzag: red in front, green behind, blue in front.
instructions.Dog Cube Row Arrangement: Place D, O, G from left to right facing the robot.
instructions.Dual Cube Side Placement: Place red left of the green patch and blue right of it.
instructions.Dual Cube Stacking: Build two separate stacks of two cubes, about 10 cm apart.
instructions.Dual Patch Cube Pair Placement: Put two cubes on each of the two patches.
instructions.Five Plus Shape: Make a plus sign with red in the center and the other cubes as arms.
instructions.Front Edge Cube Row: Make a left-to-right row along the front edge.
instructions.Front To Back Cube Line: Line up red, green, and blue from nearest to farthest.
instructions.Green Cube On Yellow Target: Place the green cube on the yellow target patch.
instructions.Green Patch Corner Guarding: Place one cube at each corner of the green patch.
instructions.Hello Semantic Cubes 1x5 Line: Spell HELLO from left to right with the letters facing the robot.
instructions.Hi Cube Placement: Put H on the left and I on the right to read HI.
instructions.L Cube Arrangement: Place red left, blue middle, green right, and yellow behind green.
instructions.Letter Face Alignment: Rotate the letter cube so the requested letter is upright and readable.
instructions.Microsoft Logo Cubes: Red back-left, green back-right, blue front-left, yellow front-right.
instructions.Opposite Corner Cube Placement: Put red on the front-left target and green on the back-right target.
instructions.Patch Stack And Place: Put red on the green patch and blue next to the patch.
instructions.Place Cube On Each Patch: Put each cube on the patch of its own color.
instructions.Push Block to Target: Push every block onto the target patch.
instructions.Red Behind Blue Placement: Put the red cube behind the blue cube.
instructions.Red Cube Center Placement: Place the red cube at the center of the green patch.
instructions.Red Cube In Front Of Blue Cube: Put the red cube in front of the blue cube.
instructions.Red Left Of Blue Placement: Put the red cube on the left side of the blue cube.
instructions.Red On Semantic Cube Stacking: Stack red on the letter cube with A facing the robot.
instructions.Rotate Letter Block: Rotate the block so E is on top.
instructions.Semantic Cube Blue B Placement: Put the letter cube on the blue patch with B facing up.
instructions.Semantic Cube Green Target Red Stack: Stack red on the letter cube on the green patch, A facing the robot.
instructions.Semantic Cube On Red Patch A Up: Put the letter cube on the red patch with A facing up.
instructions.Semantic Cube Pyramid Build: Build a letter pyramid with B left, C right, and A on top, all facing the robot.
instructions.Semantic Cubes 1x4 Line 1234: Make a row that reads 1234 toward the robot.
instructions.Sequential Push Block to Target: Push red to the red target, then blue to the blue target.
instructions.Single Row Alphabetical Letters Top Down: Line up the letters alphabetically from front to back, facing the robot.
instructions.Spell Ok Cube Alignment: Make the cubes spell OK facing the robot.
instructions.Three Cube Pyramid Stacking: Make a small pyramid: green and blue below, red above.
instructions.Three Cube Wall Row: Place red in front, green behind it, blue at the back.
instructions.Three Step Cube Staircase: Line up red, green, blue from front to back, stack yellow on green, and purple then orange on blue.
instructions.Three Step Staircase Stack Six Cubes: Build a three-level staircase with all six cubes.
instructions.Top Letter Cube Stacking: Stack the letter cube on the base cube, requested letter readable.
instructions.Two Row Colors And Letters Arrangement: Make a front row red, green, blue and a back row A, B, C facing the robot.
instructions.Vertical Insert Two Blocks: Lift one block, slide the other underneath, and stack them.
instructions.Xyz Cube Row Alignment: Spell XYZ from left to right with the letters facing the robot.
instructions.Yellow Cube Pyramid Stack 321: Build a yellow pyramid: three cubes on the bottom, two in the middle, one on top.
instructions.Yes Cube Row Arrangement: Spell YES from left to right with the letters facing the robot.
instructions.Adjacent Purple Cube Placement: Place the purple cube next to the target.
instructions.Aligned Cube Row Placement Variant: Arrange green, blue, and red left to right, oriented alike.
instructions.Alphabet Cube Row Arrange Variant: Place R, P, J from left to right facing the robot.
instructions.Alternate Purple Yellow Row: Build a row of yellow, purple, yellow, purple from left to right.
instructions.Orange Base Green Pyramid: Build a pyramid with two orange cubes below and green on top.
instructions.Blue Cube On Green Target: Center the blue cube on the green patch.
instructions.Blue On Orange Stack To Green Target: Put orange on the green patch and blue on top.
